vacancy.title: Product Assurance Process Engineer (Space Systems)
vacancy.location: Sassenheim, Netherlands (near ESTEC, not an ESA on-site role)
vacancy.assessment: Previously missed official cosine vacancy in Sassenheim. Develops PA/QA framework, ECSS compliance, audits, non-conformance and risk processes for space instrumentation and institutional ESA programmes. MSc mechanical engineering, long-running design/production work and ESA Academy PA course are relevant; lack of years in dedicated space PA/process ownership is a stretch. Strong pathway into space hardware quality, but less mechanical design and no direct ESTEC assignment. Initial one-year contract with intention to continue; salary unspecified (check against ~€70k target).
